title: B-score: Detecting biases in large language models using response history
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical detection and mitigation of LLM biases (such as gender, race, and political preference) through a new consistency metric called B-score. While it utilizes the BBQ benchmark (which includes religion as a category) and benchmarks demographic biases that intersect with ethics, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical reasoning systems.
